en_title: Gears of War: E-Day Studio Boss Insists 'The Next Game Will Not Take Nearly as Long' to Make, Responds to Layoff Concern
cn_title: 《战争机器：事变日》负责人回应裁员担忧
subtitle: 下一作不用等那么久
opus_summary: 《战争机器：事变日》开发商The Coalition的负责人回应员工对XBOX裁员的担忧，表示团队应专注于能掌控的事。他称本作将为系列后续作品打下基础，下一作的开发时间不会这么长。

paragraphs.en: The boss of Gears of War: E-Day developer The Coalition has responded to reports that staff at the studio are worried they will lose their jobs amid the ongoing cuts at Xbox, and promised the next Gears game won’t take as long to make.
paragraphs.cn: 《战争机器：事变日》开发商The Coalition的负责人回应了有关工作室员工担心在XBOX持续裁员中失业的报道，并承诺下一部《战争机器》不会花这么长时间开发。

paragraphs.en: Xbox CEO Asha Sharma’s “reset” of Microsoft’s gaming business has seen nearly 2,000 people cut already this financial year, with more to come. A number of studios have left the business or are in the process of closing down. Microsoft has also reorganized its studios, bringing Halo and Sea of Thieves developer Rare under Call of Duty developer Activision, and Grounded developer Obsidian under Fallout developer Bethesda.
paragraphs.cn: XBOX首席执行官Asha Sharma对微软游戏业务的「重整」，已导致本财年近2,000人被裁，后续还会有更多裁员。一些工作室已脱离该业务，另一些则正在关闭。微软还调整了旗下工作室的归属：将《光环》和《盗贼之海》的开发商Rare划归《使命召唤》的开发商Activision，将《禁闭求生》的开发商Obsidian划归《辐射》的开发商贝塞斯达。

paragraphs.en: "What I say to myself, what I say to the team, is we need to focus on the things that we can control,” Crump said.
paragraphs.cn: Crump说：「我对自己和团队说，我们需要专注于自己能掌控的事。」

paragraphs.en: "For us that's about shipping a great game that people are going to love and I feel like, as a team, we've done that."
paragraphs.cn: 「对我们来说，就是推出一款玩家会喜欢的优秀游戏。我觉得，作为一个团队，我们已经做到了。」

paragraphs.en: No guarantee, then, that The Coalition will escape the fate suffered by so many at Xbox this summer. But Crump did suggest there are plans for more Gears of War games. He called E-Day a "great foundation" for future games in the series, and said "the next game will not take nearly as long" to make.
paragraphs.cn: 因此，The Coalition能否避开今年夏天许多XBOX员工遭遇的命运，仍没有保证。不过，Crump确实暗示，团队有推出更多《战争机器》游戏的计划。他称《战争机器：事变日》为系列后续作品奠定了「很好的基础」，并表示「下一作的开发时间不会这么长」。

paragraphs.en: As for what the next Gears game is, in June 2024, Microsoft pledged to continue the story of Gears of War and wrap up the cliffhanger posed by Gears 5's ending, despite creating a prequel first with E-Day. The question is, will The Coalition get the chance to make it?
paragraphs.cn: 至于下一部《战争机器》会是什么，微软曾在2024年6月承诺，尽管先制作前传《战争机器：事变日》，仍会继续讲述《战争机器》的故事，解答《战争机器5》结尾留下的悬念。问题是，The Coalition还有机会制作这部作品吗？
